catalogdoc.title: Event and tool catalog
catalogdoc.intro: The catalogs that ship with the module. The standard catalogs are what the module implements end to end: the event types its gateways, Task Manager and loop produce or handle, and the tools package toolhost executes. Hosts may register more event types (contract.Catalog.Register) and offer more tools (contract.ToolSpec); see [events.md](events.md) and [tools.md](tools.md).
catalogdoc.legend.title: Vocabulary
catalogdoc.events.title: Event types
catalogdoc.events.intro: Each type has exactly one class and one mode. The lane and session decide where the loop processes an admitted event; options control coalescing, preemption and revocation.
catalogdoc.opt.coalesce: coalesce: quiet {quiet} ms, max wait {wait} ms, max {items} items
catalogdoc.tools.title: Standard tools
catalogdoc.tools.intro: Tools package toolhost implements over the contract ports. A tool is offered only in the listed lanes and sessions; `name?` marks an optional parameter. Effect tools must return a durable receipt.
catalogdoc.extensions.title: Host extension profile
catalogdoc.extensions.intro: Optional types and tools an embedding platform adds for flows the module does not implement. The platform registers its types (Catalog.Register), executes its tools with its own contract.Host (offering their specs, for example, through toolhost.WithCatalog next to the standard tools) and ships their texts in its own pack. Nothing in the module produces these events or executes these tools; examples/hostext is a sample profile.
catalogdoc.extensions.tools.title: Extension tools
catalogdoc.extensions.tools.intro: Tools a platform Host executes itself. A tool is offered only in the listed lanes and sessions; `name?` marks an optional parameter. Effect tools must return a durable receipt.
